description: Applies the SQL Server WITH (NOLOCK) table hint to individual LINQ queries via a fluent .WithNoLock() API, for EF Core and LinqToDB.
rules: Calling .WithNoLock() alone does nothing. The interceptor must be registered first: options.UseSqlServer(cs).AddInterceptors(new WithNoLockInterceptor()). Without it the query runs normally and no hint is applied.
The interceptor type lives in the EFCore.NoLock namespace; the .WithNoLock() extension method lives in EFCore.NoLock.Core. Both usings are needed.
Install EFCore.NoLock for Entity Framework Core, or EFCore.NoLock.LinqToDb for LinqToDB. EFCore.NoLock.Core is the shared engine and arrives as a transitive dependency — do not install it directly.
SQL Server only. WITH (NOLOCK) is a T-SQL table hint and has no equivalent on other providers.
The hint is applied per query, not per DbContext. Chain .WithNoLock() on the IQueryable you want it on.
Works with async materialisation (ToListAsync, FirstOrDefaultAsync, and the rest).
NOLOCK permits dirty reads: uncommitted, missing, and duplicated rows are all possible. Use it for tolerant read paths, never for reads that back a write decision.
